(none).name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
(none).flavor: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
(none).when:
Any phase, just after you make one of the following rolls for a friendly unit or model:
▪ Advance roll
▪ Charge roll
▪ Damage roll
▪ Hazard roll
▪ Hit roll
▪ Save roll
▪ Wound roll
▪ A roll to determine the number of attacks generated with a weapon.
(none).effect: You re-roll that roll. If you are rolling more than one dice together, select one of those dice to re-roll (excluding charge rolls, which you must re-roll in full).

(none).name: EPIC CHALLENGE
(none).flavor: The legends of the 41st millennium are replete with deadly duels between mighty champions.
(none).when: Fight phase, just after a friendly CHARACTER unit is selected to fight.
(none).effect: Select one CHARACTER model in your unit. Until the end of the phase, that model’s melee weapons have the [PRECISION] ability.

(none).name: INSANE BRAVERY
(none).flavor: Indifferent to their own survival, these warriors hold their ground against seemingly impossible odds.
(none).when: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just before you make a battle-shock roll for a friendly unit.
(none).restrictions: You cannot use this stratagem more than once per battle.

(none).name: EXPLOSIVES
(none).flavor: Priming grenades or other explosives, these warriors draw back and hurl death into the enemy’s midst.
(none).target: One friendly unengaged EXPLOSIVES/GRENADES unit that is eligible to shoot and did not make an advance move this turn.
(none).effect:
Resolve the following sequence:
1. Select one EXPLOSIVES/GRENADES model in your unit.
2. Select one unengaged enemy unit within 8" of and visible to that model.
3. Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (06.02).

(none).name: CRUSHING IMPACT
(none).flavor: In extremis, armoured vehicles and rampaging monsters can use their sheer size as a weapon, ramming and crushing enemies beneath their colossal bulk, though doing so risks sustaining damage in return.
(none).when: Your Charge phase, just after a friendly MONSTER/VEHICLE unit ends a charge move.
(none).effect:
Resolve the following sequence:
1. Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit.
2. Select one model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit.
3. Roll a number of D6 equal to the T characteristic of that model: for each 1, your unit suffers 1 mortal wound; for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds per unit).

(none).name: RAPID INGRESS
(none).flavor: Be it cunning strategy, potent technology or supernatural ritual, there are many means by which a commander may hasten their warriors’ onset.
(none).when: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.
(none).target: One friendly unit that is in strategic reserves (excluding AIRCRAFT).
(none).restrictions: You cannot use this stratagem during the first battle round.

(none).name: FIRE OVERWATCH
(none).flavor: A hail of fire can drive back advancing foes.
(none).when: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.
(none).effect: Your unit shoots using snap shooting (see below).

sections.label: ELIGIBLE IF:
sections.html: As stated in the rule allowing this shooting type.

sections.label: EFFECT:
sections.html: Your unit shoots as described in Making Attacks (04).

sections.label: WHILE SHOOTING:
sections.html:
▪ You can only target one visible enemy unit within 24" of your unit (and only if it is an eligible target).
▪ Each attack only hits on an unmodified hit roll of 6 (irrespective of the attacking weapon’s BS characteristic or any modifiers).
▪ You cannot re-roll hit rolls.

sections.label: AFTER SHOOTING:
sections.html: Until the end of the phase, your unit is not eligible to start an action.

(none).name: SMOKESCREEN
(none).flavor: Even the most skilled marksmen struggle to hit targets veiled by billowing screens of smoke.
(none).when: Start of your opponent’s Shooting phase.
(none).effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets either your SMOKE unit, or a unit that is not fully visible to the attacking model because of one or more models in your SMOKE unit, the target has the benefit of cover against that attack (13.08).

(none).name: HEROIC INTERVENTION
(none).flavor: Voices raised in furious war cries, your warriors surge forth to meet the enemy’s onslaught head-on.
(none).when: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.
(none).target: One friendly unengaged unit within 12" of one or more enemy units. You can only select a VEHICLE unit if it is a CHARACTER/WALKER unit.
(none).effect: Resolve a charge with your unit (11.02). While doing so, before making the charge roll, you must select one of the following modes:

modes.name: Leap to Defend
modes.effect: When selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that made a charge move this phase and are within the maximum distance.

modes.name: Into the Fray
modes.effect:
When making the charge roll, if the result is greater than 6 (after modifiers), change it to 6.
When selecting charge targets, you can select any enemy units that are within 6" of your unit and within the maximum distance.

(none).name: COUNTEROFFENSIVE
(none).flavor: In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.
(none).when: Fight step of your opponent’s Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks.
(none).target: One friendly unit that is eligible to fight.
(none).effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability and it must be the next unit you select to fight (12.04).

Gladius Task Force.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Gladius Task Force.flavor: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
Gladius Task Force.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
Gladius Task Force.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

Gladius Task Force.name: A WORTHY DEATH
Gladius Task Force.flavor: These Space Marines who specialise in close assault are ready to fight to their last breath and beyond to cut down more foes.
Gladius Task Force.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
Gladius Task Force.effect:
When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6:
• On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

Gladius Task Force.name: MIGHT OF ANGELS
Gladius Task Force.flavor: Relentless assault training allows these warriors to focus their already impressive sight into a truly devastating close-quarters onslaught.
Gladius Task Force.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.

Gladius Task Force.name: ADAPTIVE STRATEGY
Gladius Task Force.flavor: The tenets of the Codex Astartes allow for unorthodox use of combat tactics and the employment of divergent doctrinesif doing so will lead to victory.
Gladius Task Force.effect: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

Gladius Task Force.name: STORM OF DEVASTATION
Gladius Task Force.flavor: Masters of the art of long-ranged warfare, these warriors unleash utter devastation upon their enemies.
Gladius Task Force.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.
Gladius Task Force.effect: Your unit's ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

Gladius Task Force.name: RESPONSIVE TACTICS
Gladius Task Force.flavor: Space Marines know precisely when to give ground to leave enemies floundering, before surging back and driving them from the field in disarray.
Gladius Task Force.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.
Gladius Task Force.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6".

Assault Brethren.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Assault Brethren.flavor: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
Assault Brethren.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
Assault Brethren.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

Assault Brethren.name: GENE-WROUGHT MIGHT
Assault Brethren.flavor: Space Marines are blessed with incredible strength.
Assault Brethren.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.
Assault Brethren.effect:
Your unit's melee attacks have:
• [LANCE].
• Or: If the assault doctrine is active for your unit, [LANCE] and +1 AP.

Assault Brethren.name: DUTY IN DEATH
Assault Brethren.flavor: Imminent death does not prevent a Space Marine fron enacting their final justice upon the Emperor's foes.
Assault Brethren.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
Assault Brethren.effect:
When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if the assault doctrine is active for your unit:
• On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

Tactical Brethren.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Tactical Brethren.flavor: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
Tactical Brethren.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
Tactical Brethren.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

Tactical Brethren.name: DOMINATION FIRE
Tactical Brethren.flavor: The Codex Astartes dictates when firepower is best used to dismay, disrupt and debilitate the enemy.
Tactical Brethren.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit has shot.
Tactical Brethren.effect:
Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is suppressed until the start of your next turn:
• While a unit is suppressed, that unit's attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

Tactical Brethren.name: MASTERFUL TACTICS
Tactical Brethren.flavor: Such is the Space Marines grasp of adaptive tactics that even the most canny enemies soon find themselves out of position.
Tactical Brethren.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.
Tactical Brethren.effect:
Your unit can make a normal move of:
• Up to D6".
• Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, up to 6".

Devastator Brethren.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Devastator Brethren.flavor: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
Devastator Brethren.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
Devastator Brethren.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

Devastator Brethren.name: STORM OF FIRE
Devastator Brethren.flavor: There is no escaping the wrath of the Space Marines, and they use their weapons to bring swift death to their foes wherever they may hide.
Devastator Brethren.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.
Devastator Brethren.effect:
Your unit's ranged attacks have:
• [IGNORES COVER].
• Or: If the devastator doctrine is active for your unit, [IGNORES COVER] and +1 AP.

Devastator Brethren.name: HAIL OF VENGEANCE
Devastator Brethren.flavor: Space Marines' incredible battlefield awareness enables them to instinctively identify the origin of any enemy fire and punish their attackers.
Devastator Brethren.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot, if those attacks destroyed a model in a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
Devastator Brethren.effect: Your unit shoots using normal shooting, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

Terminator Storm Force.name: TACTICAL DREADNOUGHT FORTITUDE
Terminator Storm Force.flavor: The combination of Tactical Dreadnought armour and transhuman physiology is redoubtable indeed.
Terminator Storm Force.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.
Terminator Storm Force.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.

Terminator Storm Force.name: MERCILESS VETERANS
Terminator Storm Force.flavor: Cumulative centuries of military experience help these veterans' firepower hit home with murderous precision.
Terminator Storm Force.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit is selected to shoot.
Terminator Storm Force.effect:
Your unit's ranged attacks have:
• [LETHAL HITS].
• [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Terminator Storm Force.name: GUNSHIP EXTRACTION
Terminator Storm Force.flavor: Armoured gunships are often assigned to swoop in and relocate Terminator Squads in the midst of battle.
Terminator Storm Force.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
Terminator Storm Force.target: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.

Tacticus Attack Force.name: RELENTLESS ASSAULT
Tacticus Attack Force.flavor: Pressing mercilessly forward, these warriors place shots and blows perfectly, no matter their targets.
Tacticus Attack Force.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly TACTICUS unit is selected to attack.
Tacticus Attack Force.effect:
Your unit's attacks have:
• [SUSTAINED HITS 1: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE].
• Or: [LETHAL HITS: MONSTER/VEHICLE]

Tacticus Attack Force.name: TRANSHUMAN SWIFTNESS
Tacticus Attack Force.flavor: Poised and aware of their foes' every move, these warriors strike at the most tactically advantageous moment.
Tacticus Attack Force.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit has fought.
Tacticus Attack Force.target: One friendly TACTICUS unit that is within range of an objective and is eligible to fight.
Tacticus Attack Force.effect: Your unit has Fights First and must be the next unit you select to fight.

Tacticus Attack Force.name: TACTICAL FOCUS
Tacticus Attack Force.flavor: Even amidst the fiercest fighting, this squad retains sight of their assigned mission.
Tacticus Attack Force.when: Fight phase, when a friendly TACTICUS unit is selected to make a consolidation move.
Tacticus Attack Force.effect: When making that consolidation move, your unit can move up to D3+3".

Tacticus Firestorm Force.name: FOR THE EMPEROR!
Tacticus Firestorm Force.flavor: Unflinching in their loyalty to Chapter and Primarch, battle-brothers seize and held their objectives with unrelenting determination and zealous fury.
Tacticus Firestorm Force.target: One friendly TACTICUS unit unit that is within range of an objective.
Tacticus Firestorm Force.effect: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

Tacticus Firestorm Force.name: RELENTLESS ASSAULT
Tacticus Firestorm Force.flavor: Pressing mercilessly forward, these warriors place shots and blows perfectly, no matter their targets.
Tacticus Firestorm Force.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly TACTICUS unit is selected to attack.
Tacticus Firestorm Force.effect:
Your unit's attacks have:
• [SUSTAINED HITS 1: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE].
• Or: [LETHAL HITS: MONSTER/VEHICLE]

Tacticus Firestorm Force.name: POINT-BLANK BRUTALITY
Tacticus Firestorm Force.flavor: Transhuman skill and reaction times render these Space Marines' firearms as deadly up close as any blade.
Tacticus Firestorm Force.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly engaged TACTICUS unit is selected to shoot.
Tacticus Firestorm Force.effect:
Your unit's ranged attacks (excluding [BLAST] attacks) have:
• [CLOSE-QUARTERS].
• [IGNORES COVER].

Phobos Shadow Force.name: STRIKE FROM THE SHADOWS
Phobos Shadow Force.flavor: To evade one's enemies and sow confusion can be a deadly weapon in itself.
Phobos Shadow Force.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly hidden PHOBOS unit is selected to attack.

Phobos Shadow Force.name: MORTIS SNARES
Phobos Shadow Force.flavor: These stealth operatives lace the battlefield with explosive devices that trigger by mico-auspex and las-wire when foes blunder into them.
Phobos Shadow Force.effect:
If your unit is controlling an objective, that objective is snared. While an objective is snared, when an enemy unit ends a move within range of that objective, roll one D6:
• On a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D6 mortal wounds.
• That objective is no longer snared.

Phobos Shadow Force.name: TACTICAL WITHDRAWAL
Phobos Shadow Force.flavor: At an opportune moment, Space Marine infiltration units slip away from battle, only to relocate ready to strike the foe again.
Phobos Shadow Force.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.

Phobos Shock Force.name: STRIKE FROM THE SHADOWS
Phobos Shock Force.flavor: To evade one's enemies and sow confusion can be a deadly weapon in itself.
Phobos Shock Force.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly hidden PHOBOS unit is selected to attack.

Phobos Shock Force.name: TRANSHUMAN REACTIONS
Phobos Shock Force.flavor: Seemingly with the speed of instinct, these warriors reposition in response to the enemy's movements.
Phobos Shock Force.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged PHOBOS unit.
Phobos Shock Force.effect:
Your unit can make a normal move of:
• Up to D6".
• Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, up to 6".

Phobos Shock Force.name: UMBRAL EVASION
Phobos Shock Force.flavor: A combination of technological arcana and expert training help these warriors to evade the eyes of the foe.
Phobos Shock Force.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly PHOBOS unit.
Phobos Shock Force.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.

Gravis Linebreaker Force.name: ANNIHILATING FORCE
Gravis Linebreaker Force.flavor: Knowing well their duty to shatter the foe's lines, these warriors strike with devastating strength.
Gravis Linebreaker Force.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit is selected to attack.

Gravis Linebreaker Force.name: PURGATION PUSH
Gravis Linebreaker Force.flavor: Gravis assault tactics stipulate a relentless advance coupled with unfaltering firepower.
Gravis Linebreaker Force.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit has shot.
Gravis Linebreaker Force.effect:
• If your unit is unengaged, your unit can make a normal move of up to 5", and must end that move within range of an objective.
• Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge or embark within a TRANSPORT until the end of the turn.

Gravis Linebreaker Force.name: ARMOURED IMPACT
Gravis Linebreaker Force.flavor: Throwing their armoured mass into an assault, a Space Marine in Gravis armour can crush and trample their foe.
Gravis Linebreaker Force.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit ends a charge move.
Gravis Linebreaker Force.effect:
When your unit ends a charge move, you can select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. If you do, roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit:
• For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

Gravis Siege Force.name: ANNIHILATING FORCE
Gravis Siege Force.flavor: Knowing well their duty to shatter the foe's lines, these warriors strike with devastating strength.
Gravis Siege Force.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit is selected to attack.

Gravis Siege Force.name: STAND UNYIELDING
Gravis Siege Force.flavor: Ground claimed by Gravis-clad Adeptus Astartes cannot be taken back with ease.
Gravis Siege Force.effect: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

Gravis Siege Force.name: SUPPRESSION VOLLEYS
Gravis Siege Force.flavor: Laying down hails of heavy fire, these warriors pin or drive back the foe.
Gravis Siege Force.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit has shot.
Gravis Siege Force.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

Stormlance Task Force.name: WIND-SWIFT EVASION
Stormlance Task Force.flavor: Employing their steeds' pace to utmost effect, these warriors stay ever on the move.
Stormlance Task Force.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit that was eligible to fight this phase.
Stormlance Task Force.effect:
• If your unit is unengaged, your unit can make a normal move.
• Or: If your unit is unengaged, your unit can make a fall-back move.

Stormlance Task Force.name: SUDDEN ONSLAUGHT
Stormlance Task Force.flavor: Speed and shock are key to the Space Marine way of war: never more so than on rapid-strike missions.
Stormlance Task Force.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit is selected to make an advance move.
Stormlance Task Force.effect: Your unit can change its advance rolls to a 6.

Stormlance Task Force.name: HURTLING TARGETS
Stormlance Task Force.flavor: With nerves of steel and transhuman reactions, the Space Marines jink and weave cooly through incoming fire.
Stormlance Task Force.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.
Stormlance Task Force.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.

Ironclad Champions.name: ADAMANTINE TERROR
Ironclad Champions.flavor: Booming war cries through his vex-amplifiers, this Dreadnought rampages through the terrified foe.
Ironclad Champions.effect: Each enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

Ironclad Champions.name: MERCY IS WEAKNESS
Ironclad Champions.flavor: Once a foe is marked for destruction, the Angels of Death must not relent until the target is annihilated.
Ironclad Champions.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to attack.
Ironclad Champions.effect:
Your unit's attacks have:
• [LETHAL HITS].
• Or: [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Ironclad Champions.name: UNSTOPPABLE ADVANCE
Ironclad Champions.flavor: Ruins, barricades, bunkers; few such structures can impede the relentless advance of an Adeptus Astartes Dreadnought.
Ironclad Champions.when: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to move or declares a charge.
